pack_tensor_to_proto: pack a numpy array into a Tensor protocol buffer with optional chunking and compression
unpack_proto_to_numpy: unpack a Tensor protocol buffer and chunks back into a numpy array
upcast_floating_to_float32: upcast low-precision floating point numpy arrays to float32 dtype
compress_bytes_zstd: compress a c-contiguous numpy array using zstandard or no compression
decompress_bytes_zstd: decompress bytes using zstandard or return raw bytes with no compression
